description: Modernize a Ruby Order model: switch initialize to keyword arguments with defaults, normalize the status with to_sym against a frozen STATUSES tuple, add pending?/paid?/shipped? predicates over symbols, and freeze instances at the terminal state so the magic-string status comparisons in lib/order.rb are gone.

criteria: lib/order.rb takes keyword arguments with defaults in initialize and normalizes the status through to_sym, exposes pending?, paid? and shipped? (plus a generic status?) comparing against symbols from the frozen STATUSES tuple, freezes an order when it reaches the shipped terminal state, keeps total_cents, item_count, summary and to_s behavior intact, and no longer compares the status against the string "pending" or its siblings, with the README untouched.
